fields.summary: TC-668-02: LCO Code Blank When Leg isOriginal True (No Override)

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-668
Precondition: A trip exists where the flown leg matches the originally assigned leg (isOriginal=true). No involuntary change occurred. Out of Scope: LRO, RRO, Guarantees, Special Rules.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip where the flown leg is identical to the originally assigned leg (isOriginal=true, no involuntary change)
Flown leg: HOU->DAL, isOriginal=true, changeType=VOL, legType=Flying
Trip payload ready with isOriginal=true on the flown leg
Trigger the LCO Lambda with the trip payload
Trip where all flown legs are original (isOriginal=true)
Lambda is invoked successfully without errors
Verify the LCO lambda identifies the leg as original and does not apply an override code
isOriginal=true, legType=Flying, no involuntary change
Lambda classifies leg as original - no LCO override triggered
Verify the LCO code in the lambda output for the original leg
isOriginal=true, no override threshold met
lcoCode = blank (no override applied)
Confirm the DB update lambda persists lcoCode = blank for the original leg in DynamoDB
Lambda output payload with lcoCode=blank
DynamoDB record shows lcoCode = blank on the original leg
